## Meaning

This monitor fired because a fixed threshold was crossed.

Query:

```
min(last_6h):min:acme.pki.days_until_expiry{__SCOPE__} by {certificate_cn,issuer} < 21
```

**Why this threshold is a fixed number.** 21 days is the renewal lead time the PKI process requires (CSR, approval, deployment window). The number encodes the process, not the metric.

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-security-telemetry`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `auto-cert-renewal-ticket` (fully automatic) runs when triggered.

Actions: `lookup_certificate_owner`, `create_pki_request`, `notify_owner`.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `security` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `security-leadership`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
